# Logic Minor

---

The interdisciplinary Logic minor requires a minimum of 18 units, at least 16 of which must be upper-division.

## Logic Minor Requirements

---

A total of 18 units is required for the minor, at least 16 of which must be upper-division.

notes.text: The interdisciplinary Logic minor requires a minimum of 18 units, at least 16 of which must be upper-division. Students must take at least 3 courses from the combined categories of Advanced Logic, and Upper-Division Logic, Math, and Philosophy.
